speaker: Pradeep Bonde
text: The range expansion day is the most critical pattern for momentum burst traders. You scan for stocks that show a wide-range high-volume day after four to five days of weakness or flat action. This is where the probability shifts in your favor.

speaker: Pradeep Bonde
text: Volume confirmation is essential. If the range expansion day does not show volume above one point five times the twenty-day average, the signal is weaker. Volume tells you that institutional participation is behind the move.

speaker: Pradeep Bonde
text: Entries on day three or later are low probability. The mathematical advantage is on day one. After day three, the easy money has already been made and you are chasing.

speaker: Pradeep Bonde
text: Most traders fail because they do not have a complete setup. A setup is not just an entry signal. It includes the exit, position sizing, stop placement, expected profit, trade frequency, and the market conditions where it works best. Master one setup before adding another.

speaker: Pradeep Bonde
text: The psychological side is what separates consistent traders from gamblers. You need to practice identifying five hundred swing start days before you trade real capital. This builds pattern recognition at a subconscious level. Without this practice, you will second-guess every entry.
